```rust
macro_rules! make_test_inner {
    ($s:ident, $code:expr, $name:ident, $str:expr, $iters:expr) => {
        #[bench]
        fn $name(bencher: &mut Bencher) {
            let mut $s = $str;
            black_box(&mut $s);
            bencher.iter(|| {
                for _ in 0..$iters {
                    black_box($code);
                }
            });
        }
    };
}
```
